_comment: Copy to cluster.json and edit. host = the coordinator (no GPU needed, must NOT also run a worker). One worker per machine / IP, one GPU per worker (optional "gpu": index). 'type' names the GPU model and the profile directory. bandwidth_gbps: measure with `python cluster_ctl.py bandwidth --write`.

machine_types._comment: Optional: VRAM per type in GB (1e9 bytes). Defaults: T4/V100 16, L4/A10G/A30/RTX6000 (Quadro RTX 6000) 24, A100 40, A6000 (RTX A6000)/L40S 48, A100-80G/H100 80.

remote._comment: How the control node reaches nodes (cluster_ctl.py). run: command prefix, {ip} substituted (password-less ssh); pre: run first on every node (e.g. module load cuda/12.4); env: conda env name (created by `install` unless venv is set); venv: path for a Python venv built on top of the EXISTING conda env `env` (everything is installed into the venv, nothing into the conda env), e.g. ~/helix-venv; setup: activates the environment (default: source ~/.helix_env.sh, written by `install`); repo: repo path on nodes (default: same as here); shared_fs: nodes see this same directory.
